# Environments setup

NextPyper uses [snakemake](https://snakemake.github.io/) to orchestrate and execute the different steps of the workflow, which uses conda to set up the packages and environments required at each stage.

The first time you run NextPyper, this setup will be done automatically at the start of the workflow.

Alternatively, you can set up these environments beforehand by running:

```bash
nextpyper prepare
```

Which will create all the neccesary environments, and install the packages `NextPyper` will need to run the whole workflow.

By default, the environments will be created in `NextPyper`'s installation folder. You can use `--conda-prefix` to specify a different location. If so, you will need to specify `--conda-prefix` when [running nextpyper](../02-Getting-started/03-running.qmd).
